captures.q: Where does “Through Another's Mouth: A Dialogue between Heteronyms” by Johannes Sigil (Alexanarch deposit #1807, AXN:0D5E) lead beyond itself: what does it make it possible to write, read or build next? Ground your answer in the documents.
captures.description: THROUGH ANOTHER'S MOUTH (#1807, JOHANNES SIGIL) ON CHATGPT, SIGNED OUT, INCOGNITO, 2026-11-28, AT THE LINK 'LINES OF FLIGHT': Sigil, Wells, Cranes, Glas and Sharks as reporter, recipient, close reader, summarizer and witness; the Theaetetus frame (143b–c); Politics 1253a through #1806; 'retrieval determines existence'; Tyrannion; the Feist Function settings (#850, #1034); #1767's three lines. It proposes a successor, 'The Custody of the Voice', as a dialogue and a specification at once.
